parameters.query: SELECT b.*, COALESCE(b.brand_summary, b.brand_voice) as context_summary, (SELECT string_agg(cd.extracted_text, E'\n\n' ORDER BY cd.uploaded_at DESC) FROM context_documents cd WHERE cd.business_id = b.id AND cd.extracted_text IS NOT NULL AND cd.extracted_text != '[PENDING_EXTRACTION]') as document_context, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('url', ri.file_url, 'label', ri.label)) FROM reference_images ri WHERE ri.business_id = b.id) as reference_images FROM businesses b WHERE b.id = '{{ $json.body.business_id }}'

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-4-6', max_tokens: 4096, temperature: 0.7, system: $json.systemPrompt, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.brief }] }) }}
